purpose: Second-stage geometry verification and descriptive diagnosis after the fixed reference grid; not an independent blind confirmation or an origin test.
continuum_peak_method: Median of each raw spatial-column offset over the reference interval, subtract median of outer four profile values, parabolic interpolation of the maximum and its two neighbors. This measures a continuum position without candidate-core rows.
original_reference_diagnostic: Retain the original Pearson correlations. In the original order-50 pixels1000:1400 interval, also report correlations after a symmetric 8-MAD high-pass amplitude mask applied to both native and extracted-raw arrays. This is a sensitivity diagnostic and does not replace the old gate. Retain all removed native pixels and high-pass values.
candidate_display: Re-extract each candidate around the independently determined trace convention, keep raw and background-subtracted arrays, display old/new trace positions, plus unchanged native spectra. No classification or original disposition update.
